text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A after a large gain felt rewarding, but I should decide whether to trim based on its outlook and portfolio risk—not just to lock in a win.","I sold Stock C at a steep loss and later bought more Stock E at higher prices; before either selling or adding, I should compare each stock’s prospects with the best use of my cash.","Monthly account swings can be large even when I make no trades, so I should review concentration and downside risk calmly rather than let recent gains or losses drive my next decision."]}
